title: luzula campestris var. minor
intro: Luzula campestris var. minor, commonly known as Field Woodrush, is a perennial plant species in the sedge family (Juncaceae). It is valued for its medicinal properties and is traditionally used to treat a range of health issues. The plant has been reported to possess health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of reducing inflammation and preventing infection. Bioactive constituents of Field Woodrush include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, although more research is needed to fully understand its effects.
